question_text: Are you ISO 9001:2015 certified for quality management?
Do you hold FSC or PEFC chain-of-custody certification for board sourcing?
What is your average manufacturing defect/reject rate, as a percentage of units produced?
Do you edge-crush-test (ECT) or burst-strength-test every production batch, only sample batches, or not at all?
What percentage of recycled fibre content is used in your board?
Have you passed an Amazon Packaging Certification (APASS) or equivalent retailer packaging audit in the last 24 months?
What is your standard lead time, in days, for a repeat order of this size?
Do you provide a certificate of conformance with each shipment?
